```
fix: make password-reset links expire after 24 hours, not 1 hour

The reset window is configured as 24 hours, but the expiry was being
stored in a different unit than the one the expiry check reads. The
result was a token that was treated as expired after roughly 1 hour,
so users who did not act on the email promptly got a dead link.

Convert the configured 24-hour window to the unit the storage layer
expects before saving it. Tokens already issued before this change
will still expire on the old schedule; only new tokens are affected.
```
